la-flor-de-cano-cuba--linea-clasica.description: La Flor de Cano is made from Vuelta Abajo leaf in Pinar del Río and rolled totally by hand with short filler, with the Elegidos robusto as its newest size. Habanos rates it medium and stresses the balance between flavour and aroma. The smoke opens woody and lightly floral, gathers almond and cocoa, and closes on a rising line of black pepper.

thirds.notes: Sandalwood-like wood and cedar lead, with floral, grassy and earthy touches.
The wood stays as a subtle almond note and some cocoa appear, with a grassy, lightly toasted side.
Wood and almond hold on while black pepper builds toward the end; young boxes can turn slightly sharp.
